text: The purpose of this report is to recommend the appointment of Members of Council to the Hockey Hall of Fame Board of Directors.

City Council on February 4, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council nominate the following Members of Council for appointment to the Hockey Hall of Fame Board of Directors for a term of office beginning at the Annual Meeting in Spring 2026 to the Annual Meeting in Spring 2027: Councillor Paul Ainslie Councillor Stephen Holyday Councillor Anthony Perruzza
